_about: Topic clusters around each pillar (category shortlist). One supporting article per day, taken from the highest-priority pillar (list order) whose next article is 'todo'. Each article answers ONE distinct search intent that the pillar page doesn't, links up to its pillar and across to sibling articles, and must pass scripts/similarity.py (<=30% overlap with any page). Never add 'best free X', 'X for small business' or other variants of a shortlist: they duplicate the pillar. Comparisons (X vs Y) live in data/content_queue.json 'items' and need both tools in the pillar.
rules: One search intent per article; check the pillar and siblings don't already answer it.
Facts: prices/plans from category data in code; laws, deadlines and statistics only from official sources fetched the same day, listed in 'sources'.
Every article: link to its pillar in the first two paragraphs, and to 2+ sibling articles or comparisons; the build adds the pillar's Guides block.
No author names, no hands-on test claims, no invented examples presented as real customers.
